name: HYDRATE
author: swtdr34mz
summary: The MPC version of the HYDRATE VST3: a wave-morphing polysynth in the manner of the ASM Hydrasynth. Three oscillators with 219 waves and WaveScan, four Mutants (FM, Wavestack, Sync, PW-ASM, PW-Squeeze, Harmonic, Phase Mod), ring mod and noise, two filters with the classic types, five envelopes, five LFOs, a 32-slot mod matrix, eight macros, arp, effects, delay and reverb. 8 or 16 voices. Six panel-style touch pages.
